glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意) – four hands (舁) lifting an object. In oracle bone script and early bronze inscriptions, the central object had various shapes (such as a lifting tray, sometimes resembling 井). It eventually standardized into 同 in later scripts.
senses: [xīng] to thrive; to prosper; to flourish
[xìng] excitement; interest; desire; mood in doing something
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 興; s_page_origin explains the simplified 兴.
